purpose: Preregistered comparison of the Codex coding-agent runtime and the native OpenAI-compatible AVO harness

methodology.network: denied inside candidate and evaluator sandboxes
methodology.admission: independent hidden evaluator after candidate completion
methodology.pairing: same task, repetition index, seed, evaluator image, wall limit, and admission rule
secondary_outcomes: actual or explicitly labeled counterfactual cost

failure_policy.evaluator_infrastructure_failure: void both paired repetitions and rerun both with the same index

analysis.report: arm-level counts plus paired per-task outcomes; no superiority claim from aggregate alone

methodology.model_lock: Freeze exact model IDs, parameters, prices, runtime profiles, and credit sufficiency before the first comparison repetition.
